title: Glassmorphism Style
content: Apply glassmorphism with frosted glass cards using backdrop-blur-md or backdrop-blur-lg, semi-transparent backgrounds (bg-white/20 or bg-white/30), and subtle borders (border border-white/30). Add soft shadows (shadow-xl) for depth. Use light text on darker backgrounds or dark text with proper contrast. Include subtle gradient overlays. Ensure all content remains readable against blurred backgrounds. Add rounded corners (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl) for softer appearance.

variants.simple: Apply frosted glass effect with blur backgrounds and semi-transparent cards.
variants.detailed: Apply glassmorphism with frosted glass cards using backdrop-blur-md or backdrop-blur-lg, semi-transparent backgrounds (bg-white/20 or bg-white/30), and subtle borders (border border-white/30). Add soft shadows (shadow-xl) for depth. Use light text on darker backgrounds or dark text with proper contrast. Include subtle gradient overlays. Ensure all content remains readable against blurred backgrounds. Add rounded corners (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl) for softer appearance.
variants.advanced: Apply glassmorphism with frosted glass cards using backdrop-blur-md or backdrop-blur-lg with GPU acceleration. Use semi-transparent backgrounds (bg-white/20 or bg-white/30) with subtle borders (border border-white/30). Add soft shadows (shadow-xl) for depth. Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratios - test text readability against all possible background variations. Include subtle gradient overlays with proper fallbacks for browsers without backdrop-filter support. Add @supports queries for graceful degradation. Use will-change: transform for animated glass elements. Implement noise texture overlay for authentic glass feel. Add rounded corners (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl). Consider performance impact on mobile devices - provide simpler fallback. Test against busy backgrounds to ensure readability. Add aria-labels where glass effect might obscure content boundaries.
